mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1pp from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment exceeding 0.2 percentage points over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings weakness and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5 percentage points from prior month signals supply chain disruptions, which typically increases corporate input costs and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales over the past month signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where RSAFS rises > 0.3% from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI index exceeds 207.0, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that typically prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain or increase interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 207.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate indicate a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 0.2% and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts exceeding 0.5 percentage points from prior month signals weakening residential demand, which typically reduces construction sector activity and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
